messages:
sam: quick async standup — what I did: finished draft of hero copy and updated content calendar for 4/18. Blockers: waiting on final latency numbers and PR review for the benchmark post. Today: regenerate graphs, lock screenshots, prep publish checklist. pinging @rob for bench PR review :mag:

rob: got it — I can review the bench PR after oncall wrap (around 11am PT). which PR is it? https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing/pull/214

maya: heads up — infra will run a tag cleanup 3:00–4:00pm PT today. please avoid pushing the publish job during that window. :warning:

sam: ack, will avoid that window. can someone upload the raw CSV with latency runs so I can regen the graphs?

anne: uploaded the CSV to drive and added alt hero copy: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/marketing/bench-4-18.csv. left a note in the doc about caption options. :file_folder:

rob: quick bench note — the dev-run used v1-quant with a faster kernel. snippet I added to the PR: ```Results: median latency 78ms/token, p99 250ms, tokens/sec ~1200 (v1-quant, batch=8).```

sam: nice. do we explicitly name v1-quant in the blog or keep it generic as 'optimized model variant'? want to avoid too much jargon for product readers.

maya: recommend naming the variant and adding a footnote about quantization specifics. legal asked we avoid hype terms like 'state-of-the-art', so keep language factual.

rob: also pinging @lee — the hero screenshot in the PR is 1400x800 which breaks the responsive header. needs cropping to 1280x640. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/876

lee: saw this, will resize and push a new commit tonight. ETA ~5pm PT.

sam: blocker cleared then. moving publish to 4/18 6:00pm PT to give time for final review + resizing. I'll draft social posts after screenshots are final. thanks all! :tada:

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish job created for 2024-04-18T18:00:00Z by sam.
